info.title: ToStylMou API
info.description: Full API documentation for Auth, Post, and User routes

ApiKeyAuth.name: api-key
ApiKeyAuth.description: API key required for all endpoints

BearerTokenAuth.name: token
BearerTokenAuth.description: JWT token required for protected endpoints

ValidationError.description: Joi validation failed for request body

post.description: Creates a new user account. Returns user data with `flag: 4` (profile setup pending) on success.

201.description: User registered successfully — profile setup pending (flag: 4)

200.description: Conflict — username, email, or phone already exists (flag: 0)

post.description: Sets up user profile (full name, DOB, device info) and returns a JWT token on success.

value.message: User Already Completed The Setup Steps

post.description: Authenticates a user. Returns JWT token on success. Returns `flag: 4` if profile setup is still pending.
Sends an OTP to the user's email or phone. Pass either `email` OR `country_code + phone`.
Resends OTP to the user via email or phone.

value.message: Phone Number or Email Not Found

post.description: Verifies the OTP sent to user's email or phone

value.message: Phone Number Or Email Not Found

post.description: Updates user password using user ID (used after successful OTP verify in forgot password flow).
Allows a logged-in user to change their password by providing the old and new password.

get.description: Logs out the user by deleting their device token from the database.
Returns trending posts, post feed (new/following/expiring), category list, and category-filtered posts. All data is paginated via query params.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Post media type filter (not applicable for 'expiring')

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Comma-separated category IDs to filter posts

value.message: Invalid Request For Post Type Either M,V or C

get.description: Returns full post details including media, comments count, save status, rating, ranking (if expired), and more.

post.description: Creates a post with media. `post_type` must be one of: `M` (Media), `V` (Video), `C` (Compare). `ranking_expired_on` is required only for Compare posts.
Soft-deletes a post and its associated media. Only the post owner can delete.

value.message: Post Not Found Or Not Belongs To You

post.summary: Add ranking to a Compare post
post.description: Submits a ranking for all media items in a `C` type post. Ranks must be sequential (1→N), unique, and complete (all media must be ranked).

value.message: You must rank all media of this post
Ranks must be sequential starting from 1

post.description: Adds a numeric rating to a non-Compare post. Each user can rate a post only once.

example.message: Post Type Is Compare Which Does Not Contain Rating

post.summary: Add a comment to a post

post.description: Saves a post if not saved. Unsaves (soft-deletes) if already saved.
Reports a post with a reason. Multiple reports are allowed but same reason from same user is blocked.

value.message: Post Already Reported With The Same Reason

get.description: Returns profile data and posts. If `user_id` matches the logged-in user, returns own profile. Otherwise returns the visitor's view with `is_followed` flag.

parameters.name: user_id
parameters.description: ID of the user to fetch

post.description: Toggles follow status. If already following, unfollows. If not following, follows.
Updates one or more profile fields. All fields are optional. `country_code` and `phone` must both be provided together.

400.description: No fields to update or validation error

post.summary: Get saved posts of logged-in user
post.description: Returns paginated list of posts saved by the authenticated user.

post.summary: Get follower list of a user
post.description: Returns list of followers. If viewing another user's followers, includes `is_following` flag to indicate if the logged-in user follows each follower.

400.description: No followers found or user not found

post.summary: Get following list of a user
post.description: Returns list of users the given user is following. If viewing another user's list, includes `is_follower` flag.

400.description: No followings found or user not found
